text_block_list.text:
One day, while out in town,
I passed in front of an arcade—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
All right, today's definitely the day!
I'm gonna win that big ice cream cushion!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
In that case...
Rice probably shouldn't stay with you...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh, why's that? It's always fun when
Rice-chan is around, so let's do it together!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But... if Rice is here,
Urara-chan will get unlucky again, won't you...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Even today when we were having lunch together,
that stray cat ran off with your food, right?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but that was super fun!
I got to play with the kitty while eating!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll move the crane!
Rice-chan, give me directions from the side! Here goes!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh...? Rice is gonna...? 
Um... um, okay...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh~! That one looked so close!
Next time for sure~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Urara-chan...!
Your allowance... you only have enough for one last try...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Urara-chan is trying so hard...!
Rice has to do something too...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, a blackout! It went pitch dark!
Ahaha, I can't see anything at all~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Awawa...! And on our very last try, too...
It must be because Rice was here...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh~!
The lights are back~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look look! It's amazing, Rice-chan!
The crane is zipping all over the place!

Perhaps due to a malfunction from the sudden blackout,
the crane game's claw was violently swinging
up, down, left, and right at crazy speeds...

text_block_list.name: Clerk A
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry!
It looks like it broke down, I'll fix it right away!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, we get the cushion!
An apology for the breakdown, was it? The clerk is so nice!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice just caused a lot of trouble, didn't she...?
I'm sorry, Urara-chan...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh, why are you apologizing?
Did you not have fun today, Rice-chan?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I had a blast! The blackout,
the crazy claw zipping around—it was all so thrilling!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It really is always fun when Rice-chan is around!
So let's hang out again, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Urara-chan...!
Yeah, you're right... thank you so, so much...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice also... when I'm with Urara-chan,
I have so much fun, too...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yay! In that case,
let's play a whole bunch!

Watching the interaction between Haru Urara
and Rice Shower brought a heartwarming feeling
to the chest.
